subject: general
question: What type of climate is found in North Western Europe, West Coast of North America, North of California, Southern Chile, South-eastern Australia and New Zealand?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Marine west coast climate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The marine west coast climate **is typically found poleward from the **Mediterranean climate **on the western coastlines of continents.
 
• Major regions experiencing this climate include **Northwestern Europe,** the west coast of North America, northern California, southern Chile, southeastern Australia, and New Zealand.
 
• Characterized by its marine influence, this climate exhibits moderate temperatures, with winters often milder than expected for their latitude.
 
• **Summer** mean temperatures generally range from **15° to 20°C**, while winter temperatures typically fall between 4° and 10°C.
 
• In this climate, both annual and daily temperature ranges tend to be small. Precipitation is distributed evenly throughout the year, with rainfall occurring frequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Cold Snow Forest Climate: **This climate occurs in a vast international area in the northern hemisphere, spanning Europe, Asia, and North America. It is characterized by relatively wet conditions and is located poleward of the climates.
 
• **Subtropical Steppe Climate:** Subtropical steppe areas experience a short wet period alongside a Mediterranean-like climate. This climate can be found across various regions, including Europe, Asia, Australia, and North America. In Asia, it is observed in places like Rajasthan, particularly in the Thar Desert, India, and the Arabian Peninsula.
 
• **Tropical Wet and Dry Climate: **Extensive Tropical Wet and Dry climate regions are located in the northern and southern areas of the Amazon forest in Brazil, as well as adjoining parts of Bolivia and Paraguay in South America, Sudan, and the southern regions of Central Africa.
